title: Chapter 93 Bald Eagle
content:
Chapter 93 Bald Eagle

The major lords who are at war basically have no time to read the information in the [Chat Channel].

Wang Shuo is naturally the same.

Hundreds of bison have all been killed.

Outside the city wall, corpses were piled high, almost level with the wall.

Wang Shuo quickly asked the logistics personnel to come forward and take away the body.

As for the energy crystals and equipment that exploded, they are too far away and cannot be picked up yet.

Then, the one-horned rhinoceros appeared again.

The one-horned rhinoceros has a long horn on its nose, which is as sharp as sophisticated equipment.

Compared to bison, the one-horned rhino's attack power is much stronger.

The wall of light can no longer completely withstand damage, and its durability begins to decrease.

Wang Shuo looked up and saw that there were dense beasts in the distance, overwhelming.

Just when Wang Shuo was worried whether there would be birds in the sky attacking.

"Hey..."

A burst of bird chirping came from behind, and Wang Shuo turned around and looked up.

I saw dozens of large unknown birds swooping down from high in the sky.

"Air raid, alert!"

Someone yelled.

"Use a bow and arrow to shoot them down." Wang Shuo was a little nervous, but he responded quickly.

All the combatants quickly stopped killing the beasts in front of them and turned to deal with the big birds in the sky.

Among Wang Shuo's generals, only Gong Kai was an archer.

But other professions can also use bows and arrows.

It's just that you can't get professional bonuses or use skills.

Although the attack is not high, it at least has the damage of a normal attack.

A round of shooting, flying arrows all over the sky.

But unfortunately, not a single big bird was shot down.

【Bald Eagle】

[Level: Level 10]

[Attack power: 59]

[Defense: 9]

[Health value: 1450]

[Skill: Claw]

He actually had 1450 health points, which made Wang Shuo look solemn.

Another round of shooting.

Members of the cavalry team finally shot several bald eagles and seriously injured them.

Like a kite with its string broken, it suddenly fell.

Stirring up tons of dust,

One even fell to death on the spot!

The few that are still alive can only flap their wings and cling to life.

Several soldiers from the militia team quickly took out their machetes and rushed towards the fallen bald eagle.

Killed it in a few blows.

But more bald eagles kept swooping down.

Launch an attack on the territorial residents.

Although the bald eagle is large, it is not big enough to catch an adult.

This is good news.

They just kept attacking the people with their sharp claws.

Many residents began to get injured.

"Cum!"

Just as Hua Tianxiong finished speaking.

A larger bald eagle swooped down and directly grabbed a citizen.

Wang Shuo took a look, bared his teeth and his eyes were red.

He remembered that this territorial citizen was called Mosif and he was a lumberjack.

Wang Shuo took a closer look and his expression changed drastically.

This is clearly a bronze boss level bird.

This was the first time he saw a flying boss.

"Whoosh!"

Wang Shuo shot an arrow directly!

It was found that there was only 10 points of damage, which was simply not worth mentioning for a boss with a health volume of 5,000.

His face became even more ugly.

"Duan Wenxi, bring me our bronze ballista."

Wang Shuo looked at the bird boss who had captured the people and shouted angrily.

"Yes, Lord Lord."

Before the war, Wang Shuo had already handed over many important war preparation materials to Duan Wenxi for unified deployment.

He himself is the main combat force and must fight on the front line.

There is no way, there are too few combatants in Wana Village, and those carpenters and lumberjacks who are only second or third level are not even qualified to be cannon fodder.

[Bronze Ballista: A powerful weapon with a range of 1,000 meters and can launch two types of spears. 1. Bronze spears, one can be fired at a time, with an attack power of 2000 points; 2. Black iron spears, 5 can be fired at a time, with an attack power of 500 points. It requires 2 to 3 people to work together. 】

After taking a look at the ballista, which exuded a bronze luster, Wang Shuo's nervous expression eased, and he was finally no longer so panicked.
